description_rules: Use descricao curta, especifica, em portugues e iniciada por verbo no infinitivo
Nao finalize a descricao com ponto
Uma mensagem descreve uma unidade coerente de mudanca

atomicity.contract_change_committed_with_compatibl: Use ordered, separately reviewable commits when repositories are independent; record the related commit IDs in the handoff.

never_commit: SQLite runtime databases or generated test databases
logs, caches, build output, dependency directories, or temporary E2E artifacts
real company data or private conversation content

repositories.shared_harness: The current workspace is inside the C:/projects Git repository; stage only explicit Iara/harness, Iara/scripts, Iara/AGENTS.md, and Iara/README.md paths when recording shared Harness changes
